title: Monthly forecasting unavailable
reason: 39,920 eligible mass-price pairs cover 1 distinct target month(s). The minimum comparison policy requires three training target months and one later test target month. Splitting products from the same month would not test future calendar periods.

Real weekly commodity histories exist, but no strict publication-aware feature row is eligible at the retail forecast cutoffs. Observation dates and current archives do not establish original release or revision-vintage timing.

Reported changes and one reviewed cross-barcode replacement are retained, but the retailer panel has no verified dated family-response sequence linked to these monthly price rows. Candidate matches are not training labels.

target_definition.quantity: next-calendar-month change in price per gram
target_definition.aggregation: Median of observed daily unit prices within each calendar month; no filling
target_definition.forecast_cutoff: 00:00 Europe/London on the first day of the target month

coverage.identity_scope: retailer and exact raw name, not fully reconstructed product families

chronological_split.note: All labels used for training must finish and be available before a later forecast cutoff. No random product-day split.

observed_nochange_reference.label: Observed no-change reference, not a held-out model result
observed_nochange_reference.scope: Only eligible mass-price monthly pairs; volume outcomes are excluded
observed_nochange_reference.interpretation: Predicting zero change for every observed pair produces these errors. This is a single-period data reference and does not measure future skill or model accuracy.
limitations: Provisional retailer/name identities, not reviewed family histories.
Prices may include loyalty discounts; per-row offer conditions are unknown.
Large source-observed changes remain and are not adjudicated shrink-event labels.
No training, tuning, interval calibration or chronological held-out comparison was performed.

feature_ablations.name: Product-price history only
feature_ablations.reason: No earlier eligible training target period exists before March 2024.

feature_ablations.name: History plus weekly commodity movements
feature_ablations.reason: No valid chronological comparison and no verified publication-aware commodity features at eligible cutoffs.

feature_ablations.name: History, commodities and previous response patterns
feature_ablations.reason: No price-linked verified family-response sequence. Alternation between shrinking and raising price remains an untested hypothesis.

data_needed.title: More complete retail months
data_needed.detail: For even one minimal chronological comparison, collect at least three additional distinct eligible target months after/before the existing March 2024 period, with complete adjacent-month sampling and labels available before each test cutoff. More periods are needed to assess commodity lags and performance stability.

data_needed.title: Reviewed dated family histories
data_needed.detail: Connect retailer listings to reviewed old/new barcodes and document replacement timing, pack mass/count, prices, offer conditions and raw ingredient evidence. Distinguish concurrent variants.

data_needed.title: Commodity release and revision timing
data_needed.detail: Retain daily/weekly release timestamps or defensible historical availability policies and original vintages. Current archive observation dates alone are insufficient for historical cutoffs.

data_needed.title: Weekly sugar, edible oils and dairy
data_needed.detail: Acquire genuine weekly/daily feeds for the missing relevant inputs; do not interpolate monthly World Bank values or substitute oilseeds for crude edible oils.
